Treating read-later as its own mark with a separate view feels right, and archived items should stay out of both the main list and To read. Unarchiving should return them to the main list, as it does here.

For duplicates, taking me to the existing bookmark is the right response. I’d like it to open that bookmark for editing, though, rather than only highlighting it—if I tried to save it again, I may have intended to add a note, change its tags, or update its details. No second copy should be created.
